title: Age/Size-Based Directory Cleanup
description: Finds files under given directories older than N days matching a name pattern, and either reports them or deletes them -- the standard workaround for a scratch/tmp directory filling a node's disk and blocking jobs.

variables.name: MAX_AGE_DAYS
variables.prompt: Delete/report files older than this many days

variables.name: NAME_PATTERN
variables.prompt: Only match files against this glob pattern (e.g. '*.tmp'), or * for everything

toggle_groups.name: MODE
toggle_groups.prompt: What should it do with matching files
